# Ireland Total Overhaul flavour programme. All 236 blocks are player-facing and ledger-consequential.
# Registry: F01-F19 family allocation follows the canonical event-family map. H/P/A route gates are explicit in every trigger.
# No localisation, asset, GUI, decision or AI surface is generated here. Stable local keys are intentionally reserved for the owning text pass.

add_namespace = ireland_flavour_events

# F01 De Valera constitutional government | cabinet_routine | node 1/10 | knowledge: dated ledger, route profile and local actor record
country_event = {
	id = ireland_flavour_events.500
	title = ireland_flavour_events.f01_cabinet_routine.title
	desc = ireland_flavour_events.f01_cabinet_routine.desc
	is_triggered_only = yes
	fire_only_once = yes
	trigger = {
		original_tag = IRE
		has_country_flag = ireland_initialized
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_500 }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_flavour_f01_cabinet_routine_closed }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_closed }
		check_variable = { var = ireland_social_consent value = constant:ireland.zero compare = greater_than }
		OR = {
			AND = { has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera date > 1937.1.1 date < 1950.1.1 }
			AND = { has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active date > 1937.1.1 date < 1950.1.1 }
			AND = { has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active date > 1937.1.1 date < 1950.1.1 }
		}
	}
	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			set_country_flag = ireland_event_seen_500
			set_country_flag = ireland_flavour_f01_cabinet_routine_open
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_flavour_events.f01_cabinet_routine.constitutional_stewardship
		ai_chance = {
			base = 55
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_flavour_f01_cabinet_routine_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_f01_cabinet_routine_a
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_delta = ireland_social_consent }
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = ireland_social_consent }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_delta = constant:ireland.settlement_momentum_points }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = constant:ireland.settlement_momentum_points }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_neutrality_integrity = ireland_flavour_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_neutrality_integrity min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_british_leverage = ireland_flavour_secondary_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_british_leverage min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_flavour_events.f01_cabinet_routine.county_compromise
		ai_chance = {
			base = 45
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_flavour_f01_cabinet_routine_b
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_f01_cabinet_routine_b
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_delta = ireland_social_consent }
		set_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = ireland_social_consent }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_delta = constant:ireland.settlement_momentum_points }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = constant:ireland.settlement_momentum_points }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_delta = -1 }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_neutrality_integrity = ireland_flavour_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_neutrality_integrity min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_british_leverage = ireland_flavour_secondary_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_british_leverage min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }
	}
	after = {
		ireland_recompute_provision = yes
		ireland_recompute_readiness = yes
		ireland_update_settlement_stage = yes
		clr_country_flag = ireland_flavour_f01_cabinet_routine_open
		set_country_flag = ireland_flavour_f01_cabinet_routine_closed
		set_country_flag = ireland_followup_f01_cabinet_routine_closed
	}
}

		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_flavour_f15_veterans_closed }
		NOT = { has_country_flag = ireland_route_closed }
		check_variable = { var = ireland_readiness_maritime_protection value = constant:ireland.zero compare = greater_than }
		OR = {
			AND = { has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera date > 1939.1.1 date < 1956.1.1 }
			AND = { has_country_flag = ireland_plausible_route_active date > 1939.1.1 date < 1956.1.1 }
			AND = { has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active date > 1939.1.1 date < 1956.1.1 }

			set_country_flag = ireland_event_664_open
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = ireland_flavour_events.f15_veterans.lifeboat_service
		ai_chance = {
			base = 55
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_profile_historical_de_valera }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
		}
		set_country_flag = ireland_flavour_f15_veterans_a
		set_country_flag = ireland_memory_f15_veterans_a

		set_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = ireland_readiness_maritime_protection }

		divide_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = constant:ireland.value_max }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_delta = constant:ireland.settlement_momentum_points }
		multiply_temp_variable = { ireland_flavour_secondary_delta = constant:ireland.settlement_momentum_points }
		add_to_variable = { ireland_readiness_maritime_protection = ireland_flavour_delta }
		clamp_variable = { var = ireland_readiness_maritime_protection min = constant:ireland.value_min max = constant:ireland.value_max }

			base = 45
			modifier = { factor = 2 has_country_flag = ireland_absurd_route_active }
